svregblue.options.title: SvregBlue
svregblue.options.enabled.tooltip: Turn every SvregBlue effect on or off.
svregblue.options.mode.tooltip: When the world turns blue: from dusk through the night, only at night, or all day.
svregblue.options.strength.tooltip: How strongly the world is pulled toward deep blue. 0% = off.
svregblue.options.lift.tooltip: Dark areas become navy blue instead of pitch black. Higher = brighter nights.
svregblue.options.fog.tooltip: Distance fog turns blue too, so the world's edge melts into the sky.
svregblue.options.warm_lights.tooltip: Torches, lanterns and fire stay orange inside the blue world.
